minor.issue: Anon returns 423 (demo-write guard) instead of 403. Functionally correct (still blocks), but review request expected 403. Order of checks: demo_write_guard runs before _require_master.

issues: Conversion % can exceed 100% (e.g. purchase shows %150) because logic `prev = n if n else prev` keeps last non-zero: when modal_open=2, checkout=2, purchase=3, ratio=3/2. In real funnels count should be monotonically non-increasing, but for defensive display cap at 100% or explicitly flag anomaly.

(Optional low) Reorder demo_write_guard to run after master check on /admin/* POST endpoints so anon gets 403 instead of 423 for parity with the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 5003 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Continue extracting to routes/ modules (threat_alerts + analytics can go into routes/analytics.py).
_threat_ratio_scan_once loops all resellers sequentially and awaits email per hit — for large tenant counts consider gathering with asyncio.gather + timeout on _send_email.
Funnel conversion math treats missing intermediate stages by keeping last non-zero prev — masks data quality issues; add explicit `raw_prev` for downstream analytics.
PlanEventIn accepts arbitrary meta dict without size cap — consider len(json)<=2048 to avoid abuse from unauth endpoint.
